ai.seo_question: What phrase indicates the end of the prayer during the Tashahhud according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the Tashahhud is not a rigid formula but a flexible space for dhikr, where any invocation of Allah and the Prophet is validly counted as part of the prayer. However, he establishes a specific boundary: reciting 'Peace be upon us and the righteous servants of Allah' signifies the completion of the prayer, a ruling derived from the Prophet’s practice in Surah Maryam. This highlights the Shia emphasis on the Prophet’s living example as the interpretive key to ritual validity.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Al Husayn Bin Usman, from Ibn Muskan, from Al Halby who said,

‘Abu Abdullahasws said to me: ‘Whatever you say of Allahazwj and Hisazwj Prophetsaww is of Salāt. As soon as you say the phrase, ‘The greetings be upon us and the righteous servants of Allahazwj’, so you have ended (the Salāt)’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Al- Husayn ibn ‘Uthman from ibn Muskan from al-Halabiy who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once said to me, ‘Whatever you say of Allah and the Holy prophet is of Salah (prayer). As soon as you say the phrase, ‘I appeal before Allah to send peace on us and on the virtuous servants of Allah’, you have ended Salah (prayer).”’
